name: Link
description: Themed inline and standalone links with an external indicator.

anatomy.description: The underlined link text, inline within prose or standalone.
The icon appended to links that open a new tab, paired with rel="noreferrer".

dos: Use links for navigation, even when the destination opens in a new tab.
Use the external prop for off-site links so the new-tab behavior is signposted.
Write link text that makes sense out of context, not "click here".
donts: Don't use a link to perform an action like saving or deleting; use a Button.
Don't wrap whole sentences or paragraphs in a link.

examples.title: Inline and external
examples.description: Inline links underline within prose; external links open a new tab with an icon.

examples.title: Standalone navigation
examples.description: Use the standalone variant outside prose, where underline-on-hover signals the affordance.

guidance.useWhen: Navigation happens inline in prose or as a lightweight standalone action.
guidance.avoidWhen: The affordance performs an action; use Button instead.
guidance.behavior: External links open a new tab with rel="noreferrer" and an indicator icon.
guidance.responsive: Let inline links wrap naturally with their surrounding text.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from the link.

notes: Renders a native anchor, so screen readers announce it as a link and browser link behaviors work.
External links open in a new tab with rel="noreferrer"; the indicator icon is decorative, so pair the text with wording that makes the destination clear.

props.description: Composes the link styles onto a single child element instead of rendering an anchor.
props.name: asChild

props.description: Opens the link in a new tab with `rel="noreferrer"` and appends an external-link indicator.
props.name: external
